title: Benfica celebrate third consecutive Liga Betclic title
description: FC Porto - Benfica 71-93 Benfica clinched the third consecutive Liga Betclic title. They outscored FC Porto on the road in Game 4 to defend the trophy. The game was mostly controlled by Benfica. FC Porto managed to win third quarter 23-20. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They outrebounded FC Porto 43-22 including a 29-17 advantage in defensive rebounds. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international Betinho Gomes (201-1985) who helped to win the game recording 24 points and 8 rebounds. American guard Ahmaad Rorie (186-1995, college: Montana) contributed with 13 points, 5 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. Four Benfica players scored in double figures.
